predecessor.s10_result: without_mamba MSE 0.753 vs full_static 0.002647; unlike no_mamba, now add enough causal-attention capacity to approximately match original trainable parameter count

hypothesis: Under identical training examples, optimizer updates, three seeds and newly unseen joint query/support permutations, replacing the original Mamba2 computation with two additional causal-attention blocks (~1% fewer active trainable parameters) may recover performance. The S10 Mamba ablation's large error could reflect missing capacity rather than a distinct necessary recurrent mechanism.

arms.model: S6 strong content-addressed positive control, 1025 trainable params
Original official nonfused Mamba2 + 1 causal attention + static TTTLinear + fixed depth
Same original hybrid with Mamba/norm_in bypassed and frozen, 1 causal attention + static TTT + depth
Bypass and freeze Mamba/norm_in; insert TWO additional standard CausalAttentionBlock(width64, heads4) before original causal attention. Total 3 causal-attention blocks + static TTT + depth.

design.attention_replacement_is_standard: Use unmodified repository CausalAttentionBlock; first two blocks are added after original base construction. Original shared parameter tensors have exactly same seeded initialization across all native arms.
design.original_full_forward_equivalence: For full_static before training verify adapter forward bit-identically matches original AuthenticHybrid.forward on same GPU/input and exact pinned upstream sources.
design.active_trainable_parameter_matching: 89292 attention-replacement vs 90194 full = 0.9900 ratio (within 2% tolerance); inactive original Mamba weights retained in state_dict for custody but excluded from trainable count/optimizer.
design.compute_reporting: Record each arm's actual training and evaluation wall seconds and peak CUDA allocations; example/step parity guaranteed, but training FLOPs, energy, and latency not equalized. Do not call this equal-FLOP or exact architectural matching.

training.train_generator: Exact qualified S6 source get_batch; seed*10000000+step*17

evaluation.heldout_generator: Same exact S6 get_batch with NEW disjoint seed*10000000+9970000+batch*17
evaluation.permutation: Unchanged G7-S9 permuted_support_queries, per-example independent nonidentity query and pair-position permutation, preserving key-value association; cyclic roll of values is negative control.

scientific_outcome.recovered: ATTENTION_REPLACEMENT_RECOVERS_BINDING_ON_FROZEN_TASK (not Mamba universal non-necessity and not SCIENTIFIC_PASS)
scientific_outcome.note: Both variants still use causal attention; no transformer-free intelligence claim. G7-S10 null online TTT remains unchanged. One synthetic binding task only.
